Summing the authorized updates in order gives these checkpoints:

| Records processed | Budget |
|---|---:|
| #0001–#0400 | $2,277K |
| #0401–#0800 | $622K |
| #0801–#1200 | $2,246K |
| #1201–#1600 | $647K |

The initial $1,560K budget plus net changes of −$913K yields the current budget.

ANSWER: $647K
